units.source_text: 名人担心发病，才希望尽快获得解放。

en.t: Worried that his illness might flare up, the Master wanted to be released from the match as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 报社也想方设法让这盘深受读者欢迎的棋能够下完。

en.t: The newspaper, too, tried every possible way to see that this game, so popular with readers, could be played to the end.

units.source_text: 日子拖长是很危险的，那就只有缩短对局之间的休息日。

en.t: Letting the days drag on was very dangerous, so the only choice was to shorten the rest days between sessions.

units.source_text: 可是，大竹七段却轻易不答应。

en.t: But Otake, Seventh Dan, would not readily agree.
